## Key Concepts

- Online whitening learned with a lightweight model
- Joint Diagonalization vs per-bin ICA
- Cross-bin permutation maintenance
- Nonstationary mixing tracking with forgetting factor
- Dereverberation and real-time constraints
- Evaluation with ground-truth references and SDR/SIR

```python
# Pseudocode: online update loop
while streaming:
  X = stft(frame)
  W = whitening_network(X)  # outputs whitening matrix
  Z = W @ X
  A = joint_diagonalization(Z)
  Y = A @ Z
  output_frame(y)
```

```python
import numpy as np

def update_whitening(C_prev, X, forget=0.95):
    C = forget * C_prev + (1 - forget) * (X @ X.T)
```
